title: 地下車站活塞風控制
summary: 以「地下車站活塞風控制」為研究主題，規劃拆解土建與機電介面、系統整合、可靠度及測試。目前為選題路線圖，逐步課程與專案細節尚待編審；所附通用來源屬類別背景。
summaryEn: Study topic: Piston-wind control in underground stations. Planned coverage includes civil–electromechanical interfaces, system integration, reliability and testing. Roadmap entry: step-by-step lessons and project details await editorial review; general references provide category context.
